_hinweis: Handbook of the Rust version (chapters as in the Python template, content adapted to this build, 21.11.2026).
handbuch.erste_schritte.kurz: Create a career, move from day to day, play matches in FL27 or in PES M.
handbuch.erste_schritte.was: PES M is your manager's office around FL27. Here you run the club, squad, talks, transfers and finances. You play the matches in FL27 or let PES M simulate them.
handbuch.erste_schritte.ablauf:
Create a career in four steps: choose and check the world folder, club, manager name, start.
PES M backs up the world and the Sider settings into the career folder and makes its own copy of the database. The original stays untouched.
Plan the day: inbox, training, line-up, transfers.
Click Next day. On matchday you go to the match.
You play the match in FL27 or let PES M simulate it. The result is read automatically or entered by hand.
handbuch.erste_schritte.wirkung: Whatever the game needs, PES M writes into your career's copy of the database: squad, abilities, contracts, line-up, new players. Every file is backed up first, checked after writing and restored if something goes wrong.
handbuch.erste_schritte.mehr:
PES M only writes to the game folder if you allow it in the settings, and then only the Sider settings, which are backed up first.
If a knockout match from FL27 ends in a draw, PES M asks with buttons who won. It doesn't know the penalty shoot-out score and only shows “pens”.
The career is saved every week and when you quit.
handbuch.erste_schritte.tipps:
Read the inbox first: it tells you your target and budget.
The Hub shows every area at a glance.
The diary explains why each change happened.
handbuch.inbox.kurz: Everything that needs you lands in the inbox as an item.
handbuch.inbox.was: Every message is an item: Must (you decide yourself), Should (otherwise the assistant coach takes over) or Info. Breaking news and urgent cases are marked.
handbuch.inbox.ablauf:
Pick a message on the left and read it.
If it asks a question, choose an answer with a button or the keys 1 to 6.
Your answer and the reaction then appear in the message.
handbuch.inbox.wirkung: Answers affect morale, the player's relationship with you, trust, team spirit, fan mood, media image or the board. Anyone you promise something will hold you to the deadline.
handbuch.inbox.mehr:
The assistant coach answers Should items after five days, calmly and neutrally. That costs a little of your relationship with the player.
Nobody takes over Must items. If you leave them, they escalate.
Story messages left unanswered for 14 days hurt the player's mood.
After 120 days a message only shows under “All”.
handbuch.inbox.tipps:
“Needs my decision” lists everything waiting for you.
Only make promises you can keep. Breaking one costs a lot of trust.
Tone matters: warm and matter-of-fact usually go down well, harsh annoys.
handbuch.transfers.was: Find players in the transfer market. Negotiations shows what's in progress, Contracts your own players. Transfer windows are in August and January; you can negotiate at any time.
handbuch.transfers.ablauf:
Open a player and choose Negotiate or Loan.
Step 1: the transfer fee with the club, step 2: the contract with the player.
Choose amount, tone and approach. The chance of acceptance in percent is exactly the number the dice roll uses.
The other side answers at once: accept, counter-offer, reject or sleep on it for a night.
Before signing there's a medical and sometimes an extra demand from the agent.
handbuch.transfers.wirkung: A transfer changes the squad, wage bill, bank balance and fan mood. New signings need time, and rivals for their position are put out at first.
handbuch.transfers.mehr:
The other side is willing to compromise, fair or hard-nosed. Each round they move a little towards you, and their patience drops.
Pressure raises your chances but can backfire. A final offer is final.
After talks collapse, the other side won't talk for 14 days; after a rejected final offer, 21 days.
You can accept, reject or renegotiate offers from other clubs for your players.
A rival can hijack the deal; if you don't respond, the player is gone.
Loans run until the end of the season, often with an option to buy.
handbuch.transfers.tipps:
The more your scouts know about a player, the more accurate the price estimate.
You can only extend a contract from 18 months before it ends.
A very unhappy player blocks extensions.
handbuch.scouting.kurz: How well you know a player depends on your scouts.
handbuch.scouting.was: Scouts are staff with judgement, an eye for potential, people skills and contacts, a specialist area and a style. They gather knowledge about players. The less you know, the wider the estimate.
handbuch.scouting.ablauf:
Hire a scout under Applicants.
Give him a region, position and age and start an assignment of one to four weeks.
Reports arrive in the inbox; at the end of an assignment, the three best finds.
To have a specific player watched, select him in the transfer market.
handbuch.scouting.wirkung: As knowledge grows, so does what you see: first stars, then individual attributes, from 60 the character, and last of all injury proneness.
handbuch.scouting.mehr:
How many scouts and assignments you have and how far abroad you can look depends on your club's reputation. A scout only searches worldwide from level 3.
An enthusiastic scout overrates, a cautious one underrates.
After eight weeks his verdict is checked; that's how your trust in him grows.
handbuch.scouting.tipps:
Use specialists in their own area, then they work faster.
Assignments abroad cost more in expenses.
handbuch.training.kurz: Weekly plan, workload, coaching staff and retraining.
handbuch.training.was: In the weekly plan you pick a session for each day: Off, Recovery, Light, Normal, Tactics or Intensive. Individual programmes develop single players.
handbuch.training.ablauf:
Set the plan under Training or hand it to the assistant coach.
Under Individual programmes choose Focus or Extra session for up to six players.
Under Coaching staff you hire coaches, assistant coach, doctor, physio and head of youth.
Start a retraining in the player window.
handbuch.training.wirkung: Intensive sessions boost development but drain energy and raise the workload. From workload 70 a player counts as overloaded. Strong coaching staff help players improve faster.
handbuch.training.mehr:
Players go through phases: upswing, slump or crisis. These affect growth and form.
Young regular starters with good ratings can make a development leap.
Retraining takes at least 120 days, longer for a position in another line.
handbuch.training.tipps:
Schedule light days before matches.
Three hard weeks in a row hurt the mood.
handbuch.taktik.kurz: Line-up, playing style, set pieces, roles and your assistant coach's advice.
handbuch.taktik.was: Under Line-up you choose the formation, starting XI, mentality and the playing-style switches. More tabs: Set pieces and Presets, Opponent, Roles and Instructions.
handbuch.taktik.ablauf:
Choose formation and mentality and set the switches.
Swap players with a click or let the assistant coach pick the team.
Set the penalty taker, free kicks, corners and captain.
Read the opponent report and the assistant coach's verdict.
Save good setups as presets, up to five.
handbuch.taktik.wirkung: Starting XI, formation and mentality decide your strength in the match. A player out of position gives you less. Instructions affect workload: pressing costs more energy.
handbuch.taktik.mehr:
The opponent report covers strength, form, key players, weaknesses and a plan.
The verdict warns, for example, about a high press without stamina or a high line without quick centre-backs.
Whether FL27 uses your roles, takers and captain only shows in the match.
handbuch.taktik.tipps: Follow the assistant coach when picking the team and you learn from it: your tactical knowledge rises.
handbuch.medizin.kurz: Who's out, who's tired, who's at risk.
handbuch.medizin.was: The Medical page shows the injured, time out and fitness. Injuries come from matches, training and internationals.
handbuch.medizin.ablauf:
Check fitness and workload before every match.
Give tired players a break or recovery days.
handbuch.medizin.wirkung: A good doctor, good physios and an upgraded medical department lower the injury risk. Injured players are in a worse mood.
handbuch.medizin.mehr:
The medical before a transfer can turn up a problem. Then you can renegotiate, complete the deal anyway or walk away.
Older and injury-prone players carry more risk.
handbuch.medizin.tipps: Rotate in good time. An injury costs more than a rest.
handbuch.manager.kurz: Your skills, your energy, your style, your career.
handbuch.manager.was: You have seven skills: man-management, tactical knowledge, authority, media presence, youth development, fitness knowledge and negotiating. Plus energy, stress and motivation.
handbuch.manager.ablauf:
Under Manager you see your attributes, condition and style.
Take time off to reduce stress, at most three times a week.
The manager profile shows reputation, career, job offers and vacancies.
handbuch.manager.wirkung: Your skills strengthen or weaken talks, media appearances, negotiations, youth work and injury prevention. From stress 70 or with energy below 30, all of them drop.
handbuch.manager.mehr:
You don't choose your style; it comes from how you behave: tough, caring, diplomatic or matey.
Your contract runs for 18 months; with enough trust the board extends it.
You apply for vacancies in four steps. How it lands depends on the board's attitude.
Job offers are valid for 14 days.
handbuch.manager.tipps: Take time off regularly, or you'll work with penalties.
handbuch.verein.kurz: Board, targets, money, sponsors, stadium and fans.
handbuch.verein.was: Under Finances you see transactions, tickets, sponsors, stadium and facilities, and the fans. The board judges you on the season target.
handbuch.verein.ablauf:
Set ticket prices and merchandise.
Accept sponsor offers for shirt, kit supplier and stadium name.
Upgrade stadium, fan shop, training, youth and medical level by level.
Hold fan events when the mood needs a lift.
handbuch.verein.wirkung: High prices bring more money per seat, but emptier stands and a worse mood. An upgrade costs money first and takes effect after construction.
handbuch.verein.mehr:
Wages may be at most 62 % of expected income; if debts get too high, the board blocks new contracts.
50 % of the monthly surplus goes into the transfer budget, 70 % with high trust, 20 % with distrust.
If trust drops below 25, the board gives you a 60-day ultimatum. If it isn't back at 35 by then, you're sacked.
handbuch.verein.tipps:
The Club climate page shows where trust, fan mood and media image come from.
Sponsor offers are valid for 45 days.
handbuch.jugend.kurz: Find, develop, promote or loan out talent.
handbuch.jugend.was: In the academy 16- and 17-year-olds learn; in the U23s 18- to 22-year-olds play. The youth network finds you talent from other countries.
handbuch.jugend.ablauf:
Under Youth you see the U23s and the academy.
In the Youth network tab you invest per country. From network strength 20 talents appear, from 35 you can sign them; that takes 28 days.
When a U23 player is ready, the head of youth suggests promoting him.
handbuch.jugend.wirkung: Games for the U23s, a mentor and good coaching staff speed up development. Without matches, the academy develops players more slowly.
handbuch.jugend.mehr:
Every summer a new intake of three to six talents arrives; an upgraded youth centre makes them stronger.
If a U23 player doesn't play for four weeks, his parents ask why. You can promise playing time, ask for patience or loan him out.
In the year of his 23rd birthday a player leaves the U23s: promote him or let him go.
handbuch.jugend.tipps: A good head of youth makes your network grow faster.
handbuch.kabine.kurz: Morale, hierarchy, relationships, disputes and your word.
handbuch.kabine.was: The dressing room shows who is happy and who isn't, who leads and who gets on with whom. Every player has a character and a type.
handbuch.kabine.ablauf:
Check the mood and its reasons in the player window.
Use Talk to encourage a player, once a week.
Disputes, incidents and requests arrive in the inbox as items.
After the match the assistant coach asks about your half-time talk; before the match the press asks about mind games.
handbuch.kabine.wirkung: Morale moves a little towards its target every day. The target comes from playing time, success, wages, contract, promises, talks, friends, form and team spirit.
handbuch.kabine.mehr:
Captain and vice-captain are the most senior players with enough leadership; you can pick the captain yourself.
Punishments affect mood, relationship and team spirit. Sparing regular starters while punishing others costs team spirit.
A player who badly wants to leave protests if you turn down an offer: first unrest, then refusing to train and play.
handbuch.kabine.tipps: An honest no is better than a broken promise.
handbuch.medien.kurz: What you say today is in tomorrow's paper.
handbuch.medien.was: Before and after every match there's a press conference with up to four questions. Journalists have a style and an attitude towards you.
handbuch.medien.ablauf:
Under Press you answer question by question with a tone.
You can also skip it, which costs media image.
You can deny rumours about your players or stay silent.
handbuch.medien.wirkung: Tones affect media image, board, fans and morale, at most 6 points per value per conference. If a journalist likes your answer, it has a bigger effect.
handbuch.medien.mehr:
Promises to the press are public promises, for example that a player stays or that the season target will be reached.
A denial is checked after 45 days. If the player leaves anyway, it damages your reputation.
handbuch.medien.tipps: After defeats, honesty is usually safe.
handbuch.zeitung.kurz: The newspaper tells the story of your season; the diary records every reason.
handbuch.zeitung.was: The newspaper collects headlines about your club and the world. The diary lists every change with date, amount and reason.
handbuch.zeitung.ablauf:
Open Newspaper for the latest news.
Open Diary to see why morale, trust, fan mood or character changed.
handbuch.zeitung.wirkung: Neither changes anything by itself; they show what happened.
handbuch.zeitung.mehr: Every week, “The week around the world” in your inbox sums up what went on at other clubs.
handbuch.zeitung.tipps: If a change surprises you, the reason is in the diary.
handbuch.saisonende.kurz: Review, awards, promotion and relegation, new season.
handbuch.saisonende.was: At the end of the season the board takes stock. Champions, promoted and relegated teams, cup and European cup winners are decided, and the awards are handed out.
handbuch.saisonende.ablauf:
Read the season review in the inbox.
Club history shows your career, titles and awards; Rankings shows top scorers and best-rated players.
handbuch.saisonende.wirkung: Hitting or missing the season target moves trust and fan mood. Expired contracts end, loan players return, a new intake arrives.
handbuch.saisonende.mehr:
Awards go to the Player of the Season and the top scorer in each league.
European places are decided by the table.
handbuch.saisonende.tipps: Extend important contracts in time; otherwise players leave on a free.
handbuch.einstellungen.kurz: Look, sound, FL27 and the numbers behind the game world.
handbuch.einstellungen.was: In Options you choose the theme (Sunday light, Floodlights dark), sound and whether PES M may work with FL27. Rules and customisation lists all rule files.
handbuch.einstellungen.ablauf:
Open Rules and customisation and click Customise on a file.
PES M makes a copy in the data folder. Change the numbers in it with a text editor.
Restart PES M; the copy then replaces the built-in numbers.
handbuch.einstellungen.wirkung: A copy only overrides the values it contains. Delete it and the template numbers apply again.
handbuch.einstellungen.mehr:
Broken copies are ignored and reported on the page.
Under Pro details you see how long a day takes and how big the save is.
handbuch.einstellungen.tipps: Change a little at a time, so you can see the effect.
